notes: GLiFormer Large v1 NER LiteRT (litert-community/GLiFormer-Large-NER-LiteRT, published 2026-09-26, Hub revision dee6ced): the entity-extraction path of knowledgator/gliformer-large-v1 (rev d0a4e53d; DeBERTa-large 24-layer encoder + word BiLSTM + span scorer, 5 labels), encoder graph of the s512 split window (embedding LayerNorm + the 24 DeBERTa layers, window N=512 encoded tokens): inputs inputs_embeds [1,512,1024] / attention_mask [1,512] float32, output output_0 [1,1,512,1024] hidden states that the s512 head graph consumes unchanged (encoder_hidden). The split exists because the single s256 graph (14,341 operators, unpublished) crashed CompiledModel creation on the S26 GPU (SIGSEGV in the OpenCL driver, results/gpu_round4_s256_wfp16.json; LiteRT issue 10300), while the encoder alone compiles in one partition at every window. wfp16 storage: 144 float16 weight tensors read through a DEQUANTIZE to float32, everything else float32 (1,773 operators vs 1,629 in the fp32 reference). GpuOptions(precision = FP32) is the validated Android setting; with GpuOptions omitted (the runtime's default GPU precision) the s128 wfp16 graph compiled and returned finite logits but 0/10 entity span sets (recorded in the s128 wfp16 file). artifact_sha256 = the on-device sha256 of the pushed file (the run directory's *_hash_*.stdout.log), equal to the Hub LFS sha256 (resolve URL x-linked-etag, read 2026-09-26), public/manifest.json and the local public/ copy.
